They currently play in the {{Welsh football updater|Haverfo}}. The club was founded in 1899 and was variously known as '''Haverfordwest FC''', '''Haverfordwest Town''', and '''Haverfordwest Athletic''' before adopting the current name, and plays at the [[Bridge Meadow Stadium|Ogi Bridge Meadow Stadium]], [[Haverfordwest]], which accommodates 2,100 spectators.[http://www.worldstadiums.com/europe/countries/united_kingdom/wales.shtml www.worldstadiums.com] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100327204720/http://www.worldstadiums.com/europe/countries/united_kingdom/wales.shtml |date=27 March 2010 }}"}}
